classification.plainSummary: This resolution sets the procedural rules for the House to debate four separate measures. One is a spending bill for energy and water programs in fiscal year 2026. The other three are resolutions that would block Bureau of Land Management resource-management plans for field offices in Montana, North Dakota, and Alaska.

industries.rationale: The Bureau of Land Management resource-management plans govern oil, gas, and coal leasing on federal lands in the affected regions.
The energy and water appropriations bill funds renewable energy programs and the BLM plans may affect renewable energy development on federal lands.
The energy and water appropriations bill funds agencies that regulate and support electric utilities and water infrastructure.
The energy and water appropriations bill includes funding for water development and related agencies.

method.formula: score = Σ_industries ( donorShare(industry) × billWeight(industry) ), where billWeight = classifierConfidence / Σ classifierConfidence. Range 0–1, read as a weighted share of disclosed itemized money.

ordinary.text: They wrote this bill. Sponsoring a bill about your own district's industry is the ordinary case, not the odd one.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
